description: This file defines the ContentManagementServices class, which provides a set of static methods for managing content within the OFBiz framework. The methods include functionality for retrieving, persisting, updating content and content associations, managing site roles, reordering content, changing content types, and more. It acts as a service layer interfacing with content entities, caches, and other system components.

classes.name: ContentManagementServices
classes.description: A service class providing static methods for content management tasks such as retrieval, creation, update, role management, content reordering, type changes, and cache management within the OFBiz content module.

methods.name: getSubContent
methods.description: Retrieves sub-content related to a given content ID and mapKey, utilizing ContentWorker's cache functions.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Retrieves content view object for a given content ID from cache.

methods.name: persistContentAndAssoc
methods.description: Creates or updates content entities, associated data resources, electronic text, content associations, and manages related permissions and states.

methods.name: updateSiteRoles
methods.description: Associates site content with user parties by creating or deactivating ContentRole entities.

methods.name: persistDataResourceAndData
methods.description: Initiates persistence of data resources and related data, checking permissions beforehand.

methods.name: persistDataResourceAndDataMethod
methods.description: Handles actual creation or update of data resources and associated binary or text data, including file uploads.

methods.name: addRoleToUser
methods.description: Adds content roles to all user logins associated with a given party.

methods.name: updateSiteRolesDyn
methods.description: Dynamically updates site roles for a party on specific sites, creating or deactivating roles as needed.

methods.name: updateOrRemove
methods.description: Creates or removes entity records based on action parameter and primary key fields.

methods.name: resequence
methods.description: Reorders sequence numbers on ContentAssoc entities for a given parent content, optionally switching positions.

methods.name: changeLeafToNode
methods.description: Converts a leaf content item into a node, creating subcontent and updating stats accordingly.

methods.name: updateLeafCount
methods.description: Updates the count of leaf nodes under a starting content ID.

methods.name: updatePageType
methods.description: Changes the contentTypeId of a content and its children based on pageMode (outline or page), propagating changes.

methods.name: resetToOutlineMode
methods.description: Resets the content and its hierarchy to outline mode, updating contentTypeId and associated children.

methods.name: clearContentAssocViewCache
methods.description: Clears cache for ContentAssoc view from and to caches.

methods.name: clearContentAssocDataResourceViewCache
methods.description: Clears cache for ContentAssoc and DataResource view relationships.

methods.name: updatePageNodeChildren
methods.description: Recursively updates children of a content node to set contentTypeId as PAGE_NODE and process subcontents.

methods.name: updateOutlineNodeChildren
methods.description: Recursively updates children for outline nodes, setting contentTypeId Accordingly.

methods.name: findSubNodes
methods.description: Finds sub-nodes (ContentAssocDataResourceViewFrom) related to a content node.

methods.name: updateTypeAndFile
methods.description: Updates mimeTypeId and filename info on a DataResource.

methods.name: initContentChildCounts
methods.description: Initializes or updates the child leaf count for a content entity.

methods.name: addRoleToUser
methods.description: Adds content roles to all user logins associated with a party.

methods.name: updateOrRemove
methods.description: Creates or removes entity records based on an action parameter and primary key fields.

methods.name: updatePageType
methods.description: Changes the contentTypeId of a content and its children based on pageMode, propagating changes.

methods.name: updateOutlineNodeChildren
methods.description: Recursively updates children for outline nodes, setting contentTypeId accordingly.

methods.name: incrementContentChildStats
methods.description: Increments the child leaf and branch counts for a content and updates stats bottom-up.

methods.name: decrementContentChildStats
methods.description: Decrements the child leaf and branch counts for a content and updates stats bottom-up.

methods.name: updateContentChildStats
methods.description: Updates content child counts top-down, for specified association types.

methods.name: updateContentSubscription
methods.description: Manages content subscription durations for a party and content, adjusting thruDate based on useTime and useTimeUomId.

methods.name: updateContentSubscriptionByProduct
methods.description: Updates content subscription based on a product, calculating useTime and triggering subscription update.

methods.name: updateContentSubscriptionByOrder
methods.description: Updates content subscriptions for an order, processing each order item with product content info.

methods.name: followNodeChildren
methods.description: Traverses content hierarchy, following children based on specified association types, executing a service on each node.

methods.name: followNodeChildrenMethod
methods.description: Recursive helper to process each content node and its children, preventing cycles using visitedSet.

methods.name: validateUploadedFile
methods.description: Checks if an uploaded file is valid and supported, including security and format validation.
